# FDN Prayer of Binding: "Flash. When this enchantment enters, exile up to one target nonland
# permanent an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield. You gain 2 life."
# The trigger is the compiler's B13-etb+B11-exile-np-until-leaves (ontology R5-1, CR 610.3) with
# "up to one" (QAtMost(1), Barrin's form) and the moved object under MOVE_ZONE's `cards`; "You gain
# 2 life." is the trigger's second step. The compiler hung it on the cast carrier (orphaned,
# BACKLOG): the record replaces the whole tree, the carrier effect-less.
binding = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=Seq(
        steps=(
            A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
                'cards': Selector(
                    count=QAtMost(n=1),
                    mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
                    filter=FAnd(
                        children=(
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.OPPONENT),
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_PERMANENT),
                            FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Land')),
                        ),
                    ),
                    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                ),
                'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.EXILE, controller=ControllerRef.OWNER),
                'duration': DurationUntilLeaves(),
            }),
            A(Verb.GAIN_LIFE, {'amount': QConst(value=2), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
        ),
    ),
)
abilities = [binding, SpellAbility(kind=SpellKind.ENCHANTMENT)]

clauses.clause: When this enchantment enters, exile up to one target nonland permanent an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
